name: @focusgrid/focusgrid
description: Keyboard-native pane layouts and deterministic focus management for web applications.

scripts.build: tsdown core/src/index.ts --config ../../tsdown.config.mjs --format esm,cjs --out-dir dist/core --deps.never-bundle @focusgrid/shortcut-engine && tsdown dom/src/index.ts --config ../../tsdown.config.mjs --format esm,cjs --out-dir dist/dom --no-clean --deps.never-bundle @focusgrid/focusgrid/core --deps.never-bundle @focusgrid/shortcut-engine && tsdown react/src/index.tsx --config ../../tsdown.config.mjs --format esm,cjs --out-dir dist/react --no-clean --deps.never-bundle react --deps.never-bundle react-dom --deps.never-bundle @focusgrid/focusgrid/core --deps.never-bundle @focusgrid/focusgrid/dom && cp react/src/styles.css dist/react/styles.css
